key_reasoning.reason: Multi-repo changes with distinct content across 3 repos (codemie backend, codemie-ui, codemie-sdk). Backend adds a tool_output_visibility policy module, touches assistant/conversation models, routers, version/compare/migration services and share-conversation service. UI changes the assistant form, chat configuration, store and types. SDK changes cover Python SDK, Node SDK and the IaC converters/checksums, so the flag crosses shared contracts.

The new policy module strips thought/debug/tool_errors from NDJSON streams, sync and async iterators, and from history, so it is security-sensitive. It has several edge cases: payload-bearing chunks must survive, a security error message must stay visible, and U+2028 line splitting must not leak. No exact precedent exists. An Alembic migration adds a non-null column to two tables with a server default, which can be rolled back. Extensive edge-case tests are included.
51 files changed (1989 insertions, 11 deletions) across 3 repos, which is 16 or more. About 17 of the files are tests, and the rest are source files.
Covers UI, API (routers), Service, DB (Alembic migration and models), and External/client contracts (Python and Node SDKs, IaC), across multiple codebases.
